name: Interview Feedback Notification
script:
# ============================================================================== # SCRIPT TYPE: DocType Event # DOCTYPE: Interview Feedback # EVENT: After Submit # ============================================================================== # 1. Get HR Manager emails hr_manager_users = frappe.db.sql(''' SELECT DISTINCT u.email FROM `tabUser` u JOIN `tabHas Role` hr ON hr.parent = u.name WHERE hr.role = 'HR Manager' AND u.enabled = 1 AND u.email != '' ''', as_dict=True) cc_emails = [r.email for r in hr_manager_users if r.email] if not cc_emails: frappe.log_error("No HR Manager emails found to notify for Interview Feedback", "Interview Feedback Notification Error") # We still allow submission, just log it # 2. Get Interview Details if doc.interview: interview = frappe.get_doc("Interview", doc.interview) candidate_name = frappe.db.get_value("Job Applicant", interview.job_applicant, "applicant_name") or interview.job_applicant position = interview.designation or interview.job_opening or "N/A" else: candidate_name = "N/A" position = "N/A" # 3. Get Interviewer Name interviewer_name = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", doc.interviewer, "employee_name") or doc.interviewer # 4. Construct Email Content site_url = frappe.utils.get_url() feedback_url = f"{site_url}/app/interview-feedback/{doc.name}" sender_email = frappe.db.get_value("HR Settings", "HR Settings", "sender_email") or None subject = f"Interview Feedback Submitted: {candidate_name} - {doc.result}" message = ( "
